correctness.rationale: The proof uses the all-ring central-extension structure of graphical groups, decomposes each central-character block as a twisted group algebra of the abelian quotient, and identifies its bicharacter radical with the kernel of the alternating support matrix by trace nondegeneracy. The resulting character multiplicities and degrees satisfy the sum-of-squares identity blockwise in every characteristic.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Rossmann records the character-rank formula only for odd q via O'Brien--Voll and leaves the q-dependence as Question 1.10. Targeted searches did not locate the all-characteristic graphical-group formula or the complete-bipartite character count. Classical twisted-group-algebra theory makes differently phrased prior coverage a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result removes the odd-characteristic restriction for all graphical groups and gives an explicit polynomial character-count formula for every complete bipartite graph, while also extending the complete-graph formula to even characteristic.
